title: Describir dónde están las cosas
communication_goal: Describir la posición de muebles y objetos usando preposiciones básicas.
situation: Explicas la distribución de una habitación o das pistas para encontrar un objeto.

vocabulary.example: The bag is behind the chair.
The car is in front of the house.
The lamp is between the beds.
The sofa is in the corner.
The books are on the shelf.
The keys are in the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.english: No, it isn't. The drawer is empty.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: Is it behind the books on the shelf?
dialogue.spanish: ¿Está detrás de los libros del estante?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.english: Yes, it is! It is between two books.

explanation_es: Para describir posición usa el objeto + is/are + preposición: The passport is behind the books. Behind = detrás, in front of = delante, between = entre dos o más elementos. Para varias cosas: The books are on the shelf. La preposición debe expresar la relación espacial real.
spanish_speaker_notes: Behind y in front of describen profundidad, no simplemente izquierda o derecha.
Between se usa cuando identificas dos elementos o lados: between two books.
Shelf es estante; no lo confundas con self, que significa uno mismo.
En una descripción repite el referente: it = pasaporte; they = libros.

targets.text: The passport is behind the books.
The books are on the shelf.

pronunciation.tip_es: Usa objetos reales o una imagen para que la preposición tenga significado físico.

reading.title: The bedroom map
reading.text: The bedroom has a bed, a shelf and a desk. The lamp is between the bed and the desk. The books are on the shelf. A bag is behind the chair, and the keys are in the top drawer.
